text: answer[didscape-c7f6ca7766955fa2]: A "tclk job didscape" with checkable property `signed-frames-fold-to-claimed` refers to a signal-integrity or clock-tree validation task. The checkable verifies that the final count of signed (or time-coded) frames, after folding or merging across hierarchical boundaries, equals the claimed total. In practice, for a TCLK (transparent clock) job in a distributed simulation or FPGA/ASIC verification flow, this means each sub-block's signed frame counter must be folded — i.e., summed or masked — into a top-level accumulator, and that top-level value must exactly match the declared frame count in the job manifest. Success requires: (1) all partial frames from leaf instances are folded without loss, (2) folding accounts for clock-domain crossings and reset boundaries, and (3) the final folded value matches the claimed number bit-for-bit. If mismatched, review the folding script for off-by-one or duplication errors, and re-run the checker.
